text: 随着各项楼市支持政策落地见效，10月以来，北京新房市场迎来积极变化，成交活跃。在北京通州的一个新房售楼处里，记者看到，来选房看房的市民有不少，接待区几乎都坐满了。工作人员介绍，最近平均每天要接待200到300组客户。（央视）
text_en: As various housing market support policies take effect, since October, Beijing's new home market has seen positive changes and active transactions. At a new home sales office in Tongzhou, Beijing, the reporter saw many citizens coming to choose and view homes, with the reception area almost fully occupied. Staff said that recently they have been receiving an average of 200 to 300 groups of clients per day. (CCTV)
